visual_review: Inspected the generated four-window index-realtime-candles.png. The 5-minute tail and right-axis price move; the panned 1-minute window preserves its historical anchor. Price-axis label width changes are accounted for using chart width and bar spacing.
limits: Observed WS prices use the existing approximately one-second broadcast. Intrasecond extrema and missed intervals require the retained 60-second REST correction.
Volume and turnover are never inferred from index levels. Existing REST volume is retained; an observed new bar has zero volume until REST supplies its bar.
Realtime applies to KOSPI, KOSDAQ, KOSPI200 and KOSDAQ150. KRX100 has no confirmed stream mapping and retains REST. US indices are unchanged.
The four-chart fixture emits the peakWallCounts dev store-write threshold diagnostic (six registrations per mounted chart); no production registry logic was changed.
Mocked provider/browser verification only; production servers were not restarted and full repository suites were not run.
